title: Pointwise equation for the canonical affine restriction
statement: For f:X→S, G an X-module, q a natural number, h:V′→V in S.Etale and x in degree-q ordinary module cohomology of the canonical coefficient on V×_S X, affineRealizationRestriction f G q h applied to x is moduleCohomologyFMap of the induced base-change morphism and the tensor adjoint of tensorSectionsComp followed by the coefficient transport along b.w, applied to x [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. No affine, compactness, separatedness, or quasi-coherence hypothesis is needed for this defining equation. The induced morphism and its coefficient map are the constructed affineRealizationChartMap and affineRealizationCoefficientMap [def-weil-pbc-affine-pullback-coefficient-map].

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 01FD; defining equation of the tensor-composition restriction.

proof.text: Unfold affineRealizationRestriction and the typed chart map to identify the same tensorCompositeCohomologyRestriction. Apply tensorCompositeCohomologyRestriction_eq_coefficient. The defining equation of affineRealizationCoefficientMap identifies its coefficient argument with the generic coefficient morphism. Apply congruence through the tensor adjunction and moduleCohomologyFMap, compose these morphism equalities, and evaluate with ConcreteCategory.congr_hom. No quasi-coherence or geometric hypothesis is used; empty charts, zero modules, identity arrows and all degrees are included.

lean.statement:
theorem affineRealizationRestriction_apply {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) {V V' : S.Etale} (h : V' ⟶ V)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback V.hom f).toRingedSpace q).obj
      (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V)) :
    affineRealizationRestriction f G q h x =
      moduleCohomologyFMap (affineRealizationChartMap f h)
        ((Classical.choose
          (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (affineRealizationChartMap f h))).homEquiv
          _ _ (affineRealizationCoefficientMap f G h)) q x
